name: 60409 · Calumet City, IL
findings: ZIP 60409 (Calumet City) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60409 (Calumet City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60409 (Calumet City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
